hero.text: Two chefs, two cuisines — French and Japanese. Private dinners, apéritifs and a chef at home, at your place or the venue of your choice.
hero.img_alt: Candlelit dinner table set in a traditional Kyoto house

jp_line: ヴォワラ・シェフ — 二人のシェフ、二つの食文化、ひとつの食卓。

concept.title: A private dining house born in Kyoto, where French cuisine meets the Japanese terroir.
concept.p1: Voilà chef brings Kazu and Yuichiro together around one standard: exceptional produce, a short and certain list, and a taste for the occasions that matter.
concept.p2: Every table is composed to measure — for a dinner among friends, a family celebration, a wedding or a corporate retreat. French cuisine, Japanese cuisine, or both at the same table.

stats.t: chefs — one French kitchen, one Japanese kitchen
every event composed to measure, from the menu to the service

items.name: The French Table
items.text: Tradition and classics, revisited: terrines, poultry, sauces, pastry. The French apéritif, from the first bite to the digestif.

items.name: The Japanese Table
items.text: The Japanese terroir in its season: fish, Kyoto vegetables, dashi, fermentations. Apéritifs reinterpreted the Japanese way.

items.name: Four Hands
items.text: Both chefs at the same table. A fusion menu where every course is a conversation between France and Japan — our signature.

domicile.title: A chef in your home.
domicile.text: We bring the produce, cook in your kitchen and set your table. You host. For an intimate dinner or a long table, with friends or family.
bullets: Exceptional produce from the Japanese and French terroirs
Apéritif, dinner, or both — French style or reinterpreted the Japanese way
Anywhere in Japan, in Bali and in France
domicile.img_alt: Plate, candle and glass on a table set at home

aperitif.text: Cured meats from Europe and Japan, cheeses from both countries, gougères and maki on the same board, Champagne and sake in the same light.
aperitif.img_alt: Franco-Japanese apéritif board: cured meats, cheeses, gougères, maki, coupes of Champagne

cave.text: We prefer a short list to a long one: bottles and produce we know, from Japan and from France, following the seasons.
cave.img_alt: Comté, goat cheese, coupe of Champagne, cup of sake and a brass candle holder

items.name: Exceptional produce
items.text: From the Japanese and French terroirs, in season.

items.name: Wines & spirits
items.text: A short list, chosen bottle by bottle.

chefs.text: We would rather show you their plates than their faces.

items.name: Kazu
items.bio: Trained in the French school — stocks, sauces, slow cooking, pastry — Kazu serves it with Japanese precision and restraint. The classics, without ostentation; the right gesture, on every plate.
items.img_alt: Roast chicken supreme, jus, baby vegetables and purée — Kazu's cooking

items.name: Yuichiro
items.bio: Yuichiro cooks Japan in its season: fish from the market, Kyoto vegetables, dashi, fermentations. A cuisine of the essential, made for the table and for sharing rather than for the counter.
items.img_alt: Seasonal sashimi on Kyoto ceramics with a bowl of dashi — Yuichiro's cooking
